authorization: Owner instruction20 October2026 commissions JOLT-RECOVERY-001 and EVIDENCE-001 in parallel; issue48 comment6296910955 fixes this independent one-attempt development diagnostic before physical execution

case_source.classification: All24 original authored training case/seed pairs plus8 already-open evaluation cases; not a new sealed evaluation

order: Original case order; original teacher, arrival reference, then recovery candidate on each matched case and host seed

evidence.metrics: Unchanged HopTask outcomes plus receipt-derived impulses, airborne ticks, support and recovery, latency and control chatter; plain/gzip complete durable journal and full artifact/source identities
evidence.selection: One frozen recovery candidate against both preserved references; teacher gate prospectively fixed, no tuning or learned execution
evidence.publication: Original failure histories and reliability criteria retained; all paired results including failures published
evidence.wall_accounting: 900 seconds for the one whole process tree including startup, fsync, sealing, independent post-exit verification and cleanup; no automatic retry or extension
additional_limits: No forced support-removal intervention; only naturally observed contact events
Original journal truncation cause remains unestablished; this continuation does not repair or relabel original evidence

jolt-arrival-v1.pulse_room: abs(dx)-2; positive toward velocity and upward velocity only; same-height ballistic travel + supported stopping distance + reaction travel
jolt-arrival-v1.pulse_effort: positive analytic quadratic root for available room, capped by caller effort; withhold if below minimum or actual post-pulse vertical speed is not upward
jolt-arrival-v1.supported_drive: desired_x=clamp(position_gain*dx, +/-speed*effort); request=desired_x/(speed*effort); inside settling margin with abs(vx)>arrival_speed request -sign(vx)*near_goal_counter_request
jolt-arrival-v1.arrival_observation_rule: first qualifying sample starts the span; nonqualifying or over-gap samples reset it; this is a local estimate only
jolt-arrival-v1.feedback: issued own-root proprioception, support, cooldown, energy and ceiling ray; explicit caller goal and deadline; no evaluator inputs
jolt-arrival-v1.lifecycle: retire canceled/completed/replaced goals; reject duplicate/stale ticks and generation rollback; new lifetime resets state and retires prior lifetime
jolt-arrival-v1.owner_cancellation: caller must separately revoke the host lease

physical_supervisor.emergency: unstable_attitude must be explicitly requested and observed
physical_supervisor.ordinary_action: passed through without target, launch or posture decisions
physical_supervisor.expiry: exclusive original observation lease, original goal deadline and active emergency deadline
physical_supervisor.authority: retire canceled/replaced/completed goals and prior lifetimes; reject rollback
physical_supervisor.host_cancellation: caller must revoke owner; neutral output alone is not cancellation

jolt-recovery-v1.effort_limit: max(.45, caller pace); never raise it to the minimum hop effort
jolt-recovery-v1.initial_launch: fresh raw supported dwell plus six-tick anticipation; steer upward more steeply for short room
jolt-recovery-v1.second_launch: one extra pulse only after observed cooldown acknowledgment and a new physical recovery window
jolt-recovery-v1.supported_watchdog: 18 fresh ticks of supported directed demand, <=.40 cells toward progress and <=6 cells/s current speed
jolt-recovery-v1.unsupported_edge: 18 fresh unsupported near-ground ticks, <=.40 cells displacement and <=6 cells/s current speed
jolt-recovery-v1.unexpected_descent: observed supported-to-unsupported transition outside the launch interval; 12 fresh unsupported ticks, descent >=12 and below goal
jolt-recovery-v1.descent_aim: reduce horizontal aim if needed to leave at least20 cells/s upward velocity within caller effort
jolt-recovery-v1.pulse_room: positive analytic quadratic root; existing toward/upward motion, same-height flight plus conservative downward-height flight, supported stopping and reaction distance
jolt-recovery-v1.pulse_bounds: upward result >=20 cells/s, ceiling apex plus6 cells, and remaining time minus.20 seconds settling reserve
jolt-recovery-v1.anticipation: zero traction for six ticks; fresh condition and current room rechecked at launch
jolt-recovery-v1.ordinary_drive: supported desired_x=clamp(2.5*dx,+/-48*effort); ground velocity servo; no free-air traction claim
jolt-recovery-v1.ordinary_posture: lean=.16*desired_x/48; anticipation counterlean=.10; bounded .55 proportional/.20 damping trim with shared shaping
jolt-recovery-v1.arrival: raw support, distance within caller tolerance, speed<=6, wrapped angle<=.32 for12 observed ticks with gaps<=6
jolt-recovery-v1.feedback: only FeedbackObservation whitelist and explicit caller goal; no task evaluator or native mutation
jolt-recovery-v1.evidence: local reasons and requested pulses are not actual impulses, airborne or recovered verdicts

teacher_acceptance.aggregation: equal weight over32 already-open paired development cases
